brief: A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it, with five drawers in it.

requirements.requirement: Single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it
requirements.evidence: Build is currently empty (0 parts) after testing variants. A single full base at 0,0,0 would satisfy the 'single base alone' geometry, but was removed during variant testing and not restored per stop-work instruction. Even if restored, the configurator only allows 1 base cell with no neighbours/levels - this part is achievable.

Configurator offers no drawer socket on full base (find_sockets drawer =0). Half-n offers 1x drawer socket (s), half-s offers 1x (n), half-e and half-w offer 0. Tested all variants: max 1 drawer per single half-base, 0 per full base. Five drawers in a single base is refused by placement rules - no alternative sockets offered.

finish.summary: Build empty but checked clear. Single base alone is possible but currently not placed. Five drawers in a single base is impossible under current configurator rules: full base offers 0 drawer sockets, half bases offer max 1 each. Tested all piece variants via find_sockets.
